From: Aline Magdalena Lee [aline...@ntnu.no]
Sent: 29 May 2019 11:47
Subject: PhD position in population ecology at CBD

Hi,

 

We’re hiring a PhD student to work with spatiotemporal dynamics of populations and communities. I would be grateful if you could share this information at your department and with anyone you think might be a potential candidate.

 

We have a fully-funded 3-year PhD position in ecology available at the Centre for Biodiversity Dynamics (CBD), Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) in Trondheim, Norway. The PhD project will integrate empirical case studies and meta-analyses with theoretical work to study spatiotemporal dynamics of populations and communities. We are ideally searching for a candidate with some background in quantitative ecology. Application deadline: June 6th.

https://www.jobbnorge.no/en/available-jobs/job/170765/phd-candidate-in-population-ecology

 

Thanks,

Aline M. Lee
